chunks: "One who performs the prayer in full while traveling is like one who shortens it while in residence."

key_terms.السَّفَرِ: travel; the state in which shortened prayer applies
key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.الْحَضَرِ: residence; being at home and not traveling
key_terms.الْمُتَمِّمُ: the one who performs the prayer in full without shortening
key_terms.الْمُقَصِّرِ: the one who shortens the prayer

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about praying in full during travel?
ai.summary: This hadith states the legal equivalence of praying in full during travel and shortening the prayer while resident, indicating that both are contrary to the proper ruling of their respective situations. It emphasizes adherence to the divinely prescribed form of salat according to one's circumstance.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1273 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"One who prays in full (without shortening) while traveling is like the one who shortens (prayer) while residing (at home)."
